notes.title: Version 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hi everyone, here are the changes in this patch:
[list]
 [*]Added additional story elements on stage 4 that allow players to choose the normal or TLB route when the TLB conditions have been met.
[*]Added the ability to access the TLB on "Boss Free Play". This is unlocked when the player has reached stage 5 on a given difficulty/mode.
[/list]
Happy Bullet Hell'in!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
Hi all, here are some of the changes in this patch:
[list]
[*] Added game settings sub-menu at the customization screen. There is now a custom lives settings where you can adjust the number of lives given in a game. Note that scores will not be saved when custom values are used. If you have been having trouble experiencing some of the later parts of the game this is a good opportunity to try and practice!
[*] Spirit shots that have been scratched will now have a different tint to better help differentiate them from unscratched bullets. 
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Live
notes.content:
Hi all, here are the changes for patch 1.0.3:
[list]
[*]Added Boss Free Play Mode.
[*]Added toggle for Auto Bomb in Graze Mode, it is ON by default.
[*]Slightly tuned Stage 4 Boss's final pattern.
[*]Player's hit box were erroneously allowed to partially clip out of the top/bottom game area, this has been fixed.
[*]Fixed issue with Windows XP compatibility.
[*]Re-tuned the controller connection logic to combine both passive/active device connection added in the last patch.
[*]Added option to activate the controller third axis in the control/others options menu, this may fix compatibility issues with certain Xbox fight sticks. [b]Note turning this option on may cause issues when using PS4 controllers in game.[/b]
[/list]
There are still a couple of things that I'll be looking at, in the meantime  Bullet Hell on!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2 now available
notes.content:
Hi all here are the changes in 1.0.2:
[list]
[*]Addition of Hard difficulty for Graze Mode.
[*]Free play for a particular stage is now unlocked on reaching the stage rather than completing it.
[*]Quick restart is now possible for Free Play Mode.
[*]Fixed bug where passing the life extend threshold in the stage bonus screen will not award you with an extra life.
[/list]

These are some of the higher requested changes and easier fixes to get out of the way. I'll be taking a look at some of the other requests and issues that will require further investigating/code changes next!

Quick restart is now possible for Free Play Mode.

tags.bug: Fixed bug where passing the life extend threshold in the stage bonus screen will not award you with an extra life.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Live
notes.content:
Hi everyone here are the changes in 1.0.1:
[list]
[*] Addition of controller search mode in the [i]controller/others[/i] options menu. If you are having difficulty connecting controllers turning on active search mode may resolve the issue.
[*] Fixed issue of Boss Rush scores not being updated in the online leaderboard.
[*] Fixed a typo on the Stats menu.
[*] Updated the game mode description to better reflect their differences.
[/list]

I'll be looking into more specific bugs involving certain types of fight sticks and other quality of life changes next!
